name: @elnora-ai/luma
description: The entire Luma (lu.ma) API as a CLI and a Claude Code plugin — 61 endpoints driven by Luma's own OpenAPI spec, plus hard-won safety guardrails for guest, ticket, and email operations

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/main.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('src/spec','dist/spec',{recursive:true})"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && git add -A dist && git diff --cached --exit-code -- dist

author: Elnora AI <opensource@elnora.ai>
